mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, current conditions are 72 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park. If you are a star gazer, look up tonight at 10:22 PM to see the International Space Station rise over Cross Plains, travel toward Oregon, and reach halfway up the sky. The temperature will drop to an overnight low of 56 degrees with no rain expected.

The City of Verona keeps residents informed through a variety of channels including the VHAT cable channel, the official City blog, and the monthly newsletter. You can also view City Council and Plan Commission meetings on their YouTube channel or tune in to channel 989 to stay updated on local government matters.

We have a busy schedule today with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park tomorrow or check out trivia at the Hop Haus Brewing Company.
In a report covering July 13 to July 20, we noted an incident on July 13 where a 36-year-old man was arrested for his first O-W-I offense after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. Culver's is open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop. If you miss it, tomorrow's featured flavor will be Really Reese's.
